query: Newman Bbq Catering & Events, Lakeland, FL
name: Newman Bbq Catering & Events

reviewSamples.author: Neil Bass
reviewSamples.text: Newman recently catered our FBA Annual Dinner. Everything was perfect. They are so easy to work with. The smiling staff set the tone, and 85 food enthusiasts had a great time. Thank you!

reviewSamples.author: Scott Cronin
reviewSamples.text: Newman bbq catered my wedding reception with awesome food and service. They were on time, set up everything, food was great, and broke everything down. Great customer service and was open with everything they can provide. Will definitely use again.

reviewSamples.author: Jessica Braun
reviewSamples.text: Not only does Newman's BBQ never let us down with their amazing food, they always work with people depending on the event. They consistently work events for fundraisers and always give back to the community. I can not recommend Newman BBQ enough. From weddings to family gatherings they always come through.

reviewSamples.author: Krissy Sims
reviewSamples.text: I ordered a Christmas ham and it was by far the best ham I've had. I ended up using the ham bone and leftovers New Years day in my black eye peas and collard greens, talk about delicious.

reviewSamples.author: Marcus Bryan
reviewSamples.text: Huge thank you to Newman BBQ and Catering for the exceptional customer service and food they provided for my daughter's 30th birthday. Outstanding as always and I will most definitely continue to utilize them for future events.

fotos_descartadas_motivo: 3 de 10 fotos de Maps eran fotografia de stock/editorial generica (ribs/pollo/sandwich en fondo neutro, metadata EXIF con copyright de terceros ajeno al negocio), 1 estaba borrosa (mesa de postres); se descartaron las 4 y se conservaron solo las 5 verificadas visualmente como reales del negocio (evento real con invitados, trofeos de competencia con el logo Newman BBQ, montajes de buffet reales).
